intended_object: This is an auxiliary vector of integer coefficients: the "expanded core coefficients of the flat-height script" for one chamber of a case analysis in a computer-assisted gonality / Brill–Noether proof for genus-five graphs. I inferred this from the docstring and the module name.
explanation: The definition is an internal device for a certificate-style proof. It is a hand-expanded table of chip counts for one configuration (a `DegSpec 8 12` with 8 vertices) in one chamber ("second chamber", `allocFlat`) of a case split. It is built from library-specific helpers (`zeroChip`, `positiveChip`, `tailContribution`, `headContribution`, `markA`). It has no standalone meaning in the mathematical literature: it is bookkeeping data for verifying a divisor or potential certificate. So it is not a mathematical object to compare against a standard definition, and Mathlib has no counterpart.
